clue.text: Setting right about the sauce

parts.note: re is Latin-derived shorthand for concerning
a dressing is a sauce poured over salad

explanation.surface: Someone tidies up the gravy situation at dinner, fixing a problem with the sauce.
explanation.definitionFit: To redress a wrong is to remedy it, so redressing means correcting or putting matters straight.

clue.text: Turning pale, points to pass

indicators.note: turning something round makes its letters run the other way

parts.note: taken as written
two compass points, south and east

explanation.surface: Someone going white as a sheet points the way for another to get past.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turning pale' reads as blanching with fear, but it means writing the word backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: When time is said to elapse it slips by, which is exactly how time is said to pass.

clue.text: Possibly hurt, without being brutal

indicators.note: possibly suggests one of several possible arrangements of the word that follows

parts.note: the four letters to be rearranged
less can mean minus, lacking

explanation.surface: Perhaps someone got hurt even though nobody was being savage.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruthless means without pity or mercy, a close synonym for cruel and savage behaviour.

clue.text: Completely idle, but nevertheless fills up the cash-box!

parts.note: to stock a shop is to fill its shelves
a till is the drawer of money behind a shop counter

explanation.surface: A shopkeeper who does nothing all day still somehow sees the takings pile up.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface jokes that standing motionless still earns money; read the second half as a shopkeeper's action, stocks till.
explanation.definitionFit: Stock-still describes someone standing utterly motionless, without the slightest movement, as if rooted.

clue.text: A second pressing

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a moment, a split second

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests ironing something a second time; the two halves are separate meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: As a noun the word means a very brief moment; as an adjective it means urgent or immediate.

clue.text: Sports spectators could be barred

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the crowd attending a match, counted at the turnstiles
second meaning: an entrance often made of bars, which can be shut

explanation.surface: Unruly fans might be banned from the ground.
explanation.walkthrough: In British usage the gate is the number of paying spectators at a football match.
explanation.definitionFit: The crowd at a sporting fixture is called the gate, and a field entrance is a barred gate.

clue.text: Tied lace in a knot, being fastidious

indicators.note: letters tangled in a knot are twisted out of their order

parts.note: the eight letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone fussily ties lace in a knot because they are so particular.
explanation.definitionFit: A delicate person is fussy and sensitive about taste, just as a fastidious one is hard to please.

clue.text: A non-drinker, an engineer, accepting tip for service

indicators.note: accepting means taking something in, so one piece is placed inside the others

parts.note: taken as written
TT stands for teetotal, someone who drinks no alcohol
the tip of something is its end
taken as written
CE is Civil Engineer

explanation.surface: A teetotaller and an engineer take a gratuity for their service, like waiters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tip' reads as a gratuity for service, but it just means an end; it sits between the non-drinker and the engineer.
explanation.definitionFit: Attendance on someone is waiting on them, being at their service, as servants or nurses do.

clue.text: A seaman told to go elsewhere

parts.note: AB, able-bodied seaman, is a rating in the navy
someone told to go has been sent away

explanation.surface: A sailor is ordered off to another place.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone absent is not here, so they are somewhere other than the place in question.

clue.text: Reads about a pit disaster making the headlines

indicators.note: about means going around, so one word wraps the other

parts.note: to con is to study or read through carefully

indicators.note: a disaster wrecks things, leaving the words before it jumbled

parts.note: the four letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone reads about a mining accident that is in all the papers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reads' looks like the verb of the surface, but it is a piece of wordplay: 'con' meaning to study is an old word crosswords love.
explanation.definitionFit: Captions are the short titles printed above or beneath newspaper items, much like headlines.

clue.text: Speculate — the alternative is to take direction

parts.note: taken as written
or is the word that introduces an alternative
taken as written
E for east, a compass direction

explanation.surface: A choice between guessing and following orders.
explanation.definitionFit: To theorise is to form ideas or conjectures without proof, which is what speculating means.

clue.text: In some respects it's pure and simple

indicators.note: in means the letters are found inside the words that follow

parts.note: found across the end of the first word and the start of the second

explanation.surface: A remark that something is, in certain ways, quite uncomplicated.
explanation.definitionFit: Mere means nothing more than, as in a mere child, the same sense as pure and simple used as an intensifier.

clue.text: This affords very little opportunity for exaggeration

definitions.text: This affords very little opportunity for exaggeration

parts.words: This affords very little opportunity for exaggeration
parts.note: surface reading: a situation leaving barely any room to overstate things
setter's reading: an instrument giving scope for enlarging very small things, a tiny scope

explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer: micro means very little and scope means opportunity, while exaggeration stands for magnification.
explanation.definitionFit: A laboratory instrument magnifies tiny objects, enlarging images of things too small to see unaided.

clue.text: Town that's split the country

parts.note: to sunder is to split apart
a land is a country

explanation.surface: A place whose politics have divided the nation.
explanation.walkthrough: Sunderland is a town in north-east England, known for shipbuilding and football.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a large English settlement on the River Wear, near Newcastle, granted city status only in 1992.

clue.text: Where in London those entitled play tennis?

parts.note: earls hold titles in the peerage
tennis is played on a court

explanation.surface: A question about where London's aristocrats go to play tennis.
explanation.walkthrough: Earls Court is a district of west London, long known for its exhibition centre.
explanation.definitionFit: The clue asks for a place in the capital, and the answer names a London district and Underground station.

clue.text: Plant giving neat edge

parts.note: neat is an old word for cattle
the lip of a cup is its edge

explanation.surface: A plant that gives a garden bed a tidy border.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Neat' looks like tidy, but here it is the archaic noun for cattle, as in neatsfoot oil.
explanation.definitionFit: The cowslip is a yellow-flowered wild primula common in British meadows in spring.

clue.text: Tot left in flight — it's staggering!

indicators.note: in places the first pieces inside the word for flight

parts.note: a wing is the means of flight; also a flight of a building
to tot up is to add
L is the abbreviation for left

explanation.surface: A toddler, left on an aeroplane, causes amazement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tot' suggests a small child who would waddle, but it is the verb meaning to add up.
explanation.definitionFit: Waddling means walking with short swaying steps, a lurching gait close to staggering.

clue.text: One part may be variable

indicators.note: may be hints at what the letters could become when rearranged

parts.note: the seven letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A remark that one component could change.
explanation.definitionFit: Protean, from the shape-shifting sea god Proteus, means changeable and able to take many forms.

clue.text: In principle people will offer accommodation

indicators.note: in means the second word goes inside the first

parts.note: a tenet is a principle or belief
men are people

explanation.surface: In theory, people will be put up somewhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In principle' reads as a stock phrase meaning theoretically, but 'In' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenement is a building divided into flats or rooms let to tenants, a form of housing.

clue.text: Flora was promoted on call up

parts.note: someone promoted rose in rank

indicators.note: in a down entry, up means reading the word from bottom to top

parts.note: to dub is to name or call

explanation.surface: A woman named Flora got a promotion after a phone call.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flora' looks like a woman's name, but it means plant life.
explanation.definitionFit: A rosebud is an unopened flower of the rose, an example of plant life, which flora denotes.

clue.text: Not even the college governors are members of society

parts.note: odd numbers are not even
the fellows of a college make up its governing body

explanation.surface: Uneven numbers of college heads belong to a social club.
explanation.walkthrough: The Oddfellows are a British friendly society, a mutual benefit club with members called brothers.
explanation.definitionFit: The Oddfellows are members of a long-established mutual aid organisation, a friendly society.

clue.text: A letter written with school backing

indicators.note: backing means moving backwards, so the word is read from the end

parts.note: Eton is the famous English public school

explanation.surface: A letter of support from a school.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Backing' reads as support, but here it means turning round.
explanation.definitionFit: A note is a short informal written message, a brief letter to someone.

clue.text: Practise lace-work and also drumming

parts.note: to tat is to make tatting, a handmade lace
too means also

explanation.surface: Instructions to practise lacemaking and the drums.
explanation.definitionFit: A tattoo is a rhythmic tapping or drumbeat, originally a military signal recalling soldiers to quarters.

clue.text: Fail — or pass by mistake?

parts.note: a col is a mountain pass
a lapse is a slip or mistake

explanation.surface: Wondering whether an exam result was a failure or an accidental pass.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pass' wants to be the exam result opposite fail; it is the mountain col.
explanation.definitionFit: To collapse is to break down or give way, as a plan or business that fails suddenly.

clue.text: Handy source of dates?

parts.note: surface reading: a convenient diary or calendar
setter's reading: part of the hand, and also the tree that bears the fruit

explanation.walkthrough: 'Handy' means to do with the hand, and 'dates' are fruit, not appointments.
explanation.definitionFit: The inner surface of the hand shares its name with the tropical tree whose fruits include dates.

clue.text: Beast keeping capture dark

indicators.note: keeping means holding something within, so one word sits inside the other

parts.note: a brute is a beast
to net is to catch or capture

explanation.surface: An animal held captive in the darkness.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is loose: the answer is a noun for a dark-haired person, used here as if it were an adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: A brunette is a woman with dark brown hair, so the word describes someone dark-haired.

clue.text: A writer, quiet and nice, possibly fifty

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical marking for quiet

indicators.note: possibly signals that the preceding word could be arranged another way

parts.note: the four letters to be rearranged
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: An author, gentle and pleasant, perhaps aged around fifty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A writer' looks like an author, but it is the implement that writes.
explanation.definitionFit: A pencil is an instrument for writing or drawing, so it is literally a thing that writes.

clue.text: Thinking to involve the non male in negotiation

indicators.note: non male means removing the masculine pronoun from the word
to involve one thing in another is to put it inside

parts.note: mediation is negotiation through a go-between
the word with its male pronoun taken away leaves one letter

explanation.surface: Talks that require bringing someone other than a man into the bargaining.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The non male' means the word the with he, the male pronoun, taken out of it.
explanation.definitionFit: Meditation is deep contemplative reflection, the act of pondering or thinking something over.
